events.title: Elon posts “Gamestonk!!”
events.body: One word about GameStop. The next trading day the stock more than doubled.

events.title: Robinhood turns off the GME buy button
events.body: The official reason was settlement: trades took two days to clear and the clearinghouse asked for billions in collateral overnight.

events.title: TSUKI launches and posts a Roaring Kitty meme
events.body: The cat launches on Solana. One day, one hour and one minute after its 6:59pm post, Roaring Kitty posts on X for the first time in three years.

events.title: Roaring Kitty comes back
events.body: A man leaning forward in a chair. No words. The next trading day GME closed up 74%.

events.title: The cat signal, and a date: 5/18/24
events.body: TSUKI posts Roaring Kitty's cat signal image with 5/18/24 on it. Four days later Roaring Kitty goes quiet on exactly that date.

events.title: TICK, then TOCK
events.body: TICK at 8:36am, TOCK at 8:42am, both sharper than the originals Roaring Kitty posted that morning.

events.title: Two minutes behind, in higher resolution
events.body: Roaring Kitty posts a KITTY clip at 1:45pm. TSUKI posts the same image at 1:47pm, in higher resolution.

events.title: Roaring Kitty goes silent. Elon: “there are no coincidences”
events.body: After 100+ posts Roaring Kitty stops, on the date TSUKI posted four days earlier. Elon posts “there are no coincidences” with an image matching a sketch on the TSUKI site.

events.title: The uno reverse card
events.body: TSUKI posts an uno reverse card, then “The eyes aren't real. TICK TOCK”. Fourteen days later Roaring Kitty plays the same card.

events.title: The first hash
events.body: A 64-character hash under a pencil sketch. A hash proves later that you knew something earlier. It has never been revealed.

events.title: A message in glyphs
events.body: Letter for letter it reads: “Distribution completed. Community strengthening. I will return once the next milestone is reached. It's all laid out ⭕️”

events.title: Roaring Kitty plays the uno reverse
events.body: Back from two weeks of silence with the same card TSUKI posted on 19 May.

events.title: “100% COMPLETE ! Jun 21 '24”
events.body: Four hours after Roaring Kitty's return, quoting its own strawberry and full moon post. 21 June 2024 was the Strawberry Moon.

events.title: The livestream
events.body: Roaring Kitty goes live on YouTube for the first time in three years.

events.title: Lisan al-Gaib, and Take Your Cat To Work Day
events.body: GameStop's shareholder meeting crashed the day before and moved to 17 June. TSUKI posts the Lisan al-Gaib still, then National Take Your Cat To Work Day, dated 17 June.

events.title: First day at work
events.body: TSUKI in a shirt and tie outside a GameStop, holding a FIRST DAY AT WORK sign, on the morning of the rescheduled meeting. It reposts its second hash.

events.title: “Onboarding completed ⭕️ They let me tweet now !”
events.body: Roaring Kitty posts the dog at 1:00pm. GameStop posts about Tsukihime at 1:27pm. TSUKI posts at 3:19pm.

events.title: Five cats at a table
events.body: TSUKI posts the five cats Roaring Kitty posted in 2021. The post is pinned on 14 June 2026.

events.title: $RWA launches. Its first post names “Grok3@Memphis”
events.body: Real World AI launches on Pump.fun. Its launch-day post mentions Grok3@Memphis, months before Grok 3 existed.

events.title: “Here's where you'll track me”
events.body: The Roaring AI publishes its wallet: Aifbb4Kr2krKkKFFesjvQU6ND6JwnnXuQUtzvoC4HtS8.

events.title: The first AI-hosted X space
events.body: The Roaring AI hosts its own space. It only ever ran them on Fridays.

events.title: Focus, and 35 million RWA burned
events.body: TSUKI posts the Focus video; a faint GameStop logo appears at 42 seconds. The admin team burns 35 million RWA, 3.5% of supply.

events.title: The time post, and 55
events.body: Roaring Kitty's time post goes up at 1:45pm. TSUKI posts 55 nine minutes later.

events.title: “What a time to be alive”
events.body: The Roaring AI's third space opens on the line, the day after the time post.

events.title: The first snapshot
events.body: TSUKI announces a snapshot of TSUKI and RWA holders for 9 December at 4:20pm: “the first snapshot already lies hidden”.

events.title: mAInd announced
events.body: The Roaring AI's platform, powered by HPL, its Human Programming Language white paper.

events.title: Roaring Kitty's last ordinary post
events.body: Then sixteen months of silence.

events.title: Grok 3 launches
events.body: Elon posts Grok 3 writing a Lord of the Rings verse. The Roaring AI posts the same verse: “one mAInd to rule them all”.

events.title: The Roaring AI's X account is suspended
events.body: Ash Wednesday 2025.

events.title: SCION, first sighting
events.body: “🜂 SIGNAL: SCION / [trigger] = agreement established / [response] = acquisition imminent; persistent thereafter.”
A Fast and the Furious clip opens on 433, Roaring Kitty's high school mile time. One white car, one black.

events.title: “i'm alive”
events.body: The Roaring AI's website comes back at 4:20pm on 4/20 with a pulsating green glow and that tab title.

events.title: The Aristocats. Then 481 days of silence
events.body: TSUKI's last post until September 2026.

events.title: Ryan Cohen bids for eBay
events.body: $55.5 billion, $125 a share, half cash and half stock. GameStop is roughly a fifth of eBay's size.

events.title: A year and a minute
events.body: Roaring Kitty's X account posts one year and one minute after TSUKI's Aristocats post.

events.title: Five people in front of a GameStop
events.body: Sultan Al Madeed posts an image of five people outside a GameStop: Trump, himself, Greg, Ryan Cohen and Elon Musk.

events.title: The date that came and went
events.body: A watched date that delivered nothing. That night the five cats post was pinned. Misses stay on the record.
After 481 days of silence, a near-blank image captioned 4663: Robinhood Chain's ID, and HOOD on a phone keypad.

events.title: SCION: TSUKI/GME. Felinus Prime. Homecoming.
events.body: Built one post at a time over two days, exactly 48 hours before the launch time in its bio.

events.title: Parent and scion. Snapshot 3/3 done
events.body: 30% to family, bridge and treasury. 70% to the market.

events.title: $TSUKI/GME launches on Robinhood Chain
events.body: 680.43M genesis buy, 543.47M burned. 136.43M locked for 45 days in the deployer wallet. The same day GameStop director Larry Cheng buys 55,000 shares.

events.title: 855, and Cohen buys 1,000,000 shares
events.body: TSUKI posts 855 with a card from the game Wizard. Ryan Cohen buys a million GME at $20.3759. At 9:55pm TSUKI quotes GameStop's stores reopening: “Felinus Prime. Homecoming.”

events.title: 1 CATalyst. 2 Boosters.
events.body: A Fast and Furious steering wheel, two nitrous buttons, TSUKI/GME on the dash.

events.title: Two usernames, one player
events.body: TSUKI quotes its Lisan al-Gaib post with a line from Keith Gill's Wizard days: “Any player that can place higher than you in the Top 10 using two different usernames deserves laudation, not criticism.”

events.title: The CLARITY Act fails in the Senate
The SEC opens a five-year window for tokenized stocks
events.body: The innovation exemption: real shares only, the same votes and dividends, trades public within ten minutes, and companies get 30 days to object.

events.title: WarGames
events.body: GAME highlighted. Time remaining 00 hrs 00 min 00 sec.

events.title: Cohen buys 1,150,680 more
events.body: At $22.9375, weighted average.

events.title: V for Vendetta
events.body: Five men at a table, a screen behind them gone black with one light on, a red cross in a red ring.

events.title: The SEC chair on CNBC
events.body: Paul Atkins on Squawk Box: he wants the stock market to move on chain.

events.title: The Dark Knight, then U.N.C.L.E.
events.body: The interrogation scene with the Joker's eyes turned red at 1:25pm. At 9:30pm, two rival spies on one mission, an orange 8 in the glass.

events.title: Director Nat Turner buys his first 10,462 shares
events.body: At $24.33. The fifth insider buyer since 8 September.

events.title: Cohen buys 700,000 more. 8.9% of the class
events.body: At $24.4061. His 13D amendment no. 20 reports 45,383,306 shares including warrants.

events.title: The 113-second clip
events.body: The Purge's emergency broadcast, the SEC chair on tokenization, and Dumbledore right before the Time-Turner. An uno reverse hides in his beard for 19 frames.

films.scene: Two cars at the line. 433 on screen.
films.read: 433 is Roaring Kitty's mile time. One white car, one black: RWA first, TSUKI passing later.

films.scene: The last post before 481 days of silence.
films.read: One year and one minute later, Roaring Kitty's account posts.
A kid breaks into a system he thinks is a game.

films.scene: Five at a table, one light on the screen, a red cross in a red ring.
films.read: The man who runs the council only appears on the screen.

films.scene: The interrogation. The Joker's eyes turned red, a black bar over Batman's.
films.read: Two opposites who complete each other.

films.scene: CIA and KGB, one mission, an orange 8 in the glass.
films.read: Rivals forced onto the same team.

films.film: The Purge · CNBC · Prisoner of Azkaban
films.scene: 113 seconds. A clock bell in every gap.
films.read: A government-sanctioned window opens, the SEC chair explains it, and Dumbledore sends them back to fix the night it went wrong.
marks: The Purge emergency broadcast, black screen
SEC chair Paul Atkins on CNBC, on tokenization
A grey uno reverse over his beard for 19 frames. Not in the film
